anyOf.description: An OCI image reference, or `scratch` for an empty base.
Another image declared in this configuration.

Base.description: The external or locally configured image used as an image's base.

anyOf.description: A mapping with explicit source, destination, filtering, and archive metadata.

FileMapping.description: A local file mapping in shorthand `SOURCE:DESTINATION` or detailed object form.

FileOptions.description: Detailed options for copying a local file or directory into an image layer.

exclude.description: Git-style glob patterns to exclude after inclusion.

follow_symlinks.description: Follow symlink targets instead of archiving symlinks. Defaults to `false`.

from.description: Local source path, optionally selected by OCI platform.

include.description: Git-style glob patterns to include, evaluated relative to the source directory.

mode.description: Portable file mode, preferably an octal string such as `0755`.

parents.description: Preserve leading source path components similarly to Docker COPY `--parents`.

to.description: Absolute destination path in the image.

Image.description: An OCI image assembled from a base, named layers, local files, and runtime metadata.

annotations.description: OCI annotations added to the image manifest or index.

base.description: External OCI image reference or configured image to use as the base. Defaults to `scratch`.

command.description: Default arguments passed to the entrypoint.

entrypoint.description: Executable and fixed arguments used when the container starts.

env.description: Environment variables added to the image runtime configuration.

files.description:
Files placed in one implicit final layer after all named layers. Accepts either an array of
mappings or one detailed mapping object.

flatten.description: Apply the base and added layers, then emit the complete filesystem as one layer.

labels.description: Docker-compatible image labels added to the runtime configuration.

layers.description: Named layers to append in this order after all base-image layers.

ports.description: Exposed ports in `PORT/PROTOCOL` form, such as `8080/tcp`.

squash.description: Combine all layers added by Containerless into one new layer while preserving base layers.

stop_signal.description: Signal used to stop the container, such as `SIGTERM`.

tags.description: Complete image references used when publishing, such as `ghcr.io/example/app:v1`.

user.description: User and optional group used to run the container, such as `65532:65532`.

volumes.description: Container paths intended to hold externally mounted volumes.

workdir.description: Working directory used when the container starts.

anyOf.description: An ordered list of file mappings.

ImageFiles.description: One detailed image file mapping or an array of shorthand and detailed mappings.

Layer.description: A reusable, ordered collection of local files that produces one OCI layer.

files.description: Files and directories to include in this layer.

anyOf.description: Numeric mode accepted by formats that preserve integer representation.

Mode.description: A Unix permission mode represented as a portable octal string or an integer.

anyOf.description: A value used for every output platform.
Values keyed by OCI platform, with an optional `default` fallback.

PlatformValue.description: A value shared by every platform or selected from a map keyed by OCI platform.

description: A versioned collection of OCI images and reusable layers to build.

containerless.description: Containerless configuration format version. The only supported value is `1`.

images.description: Images keyed by the name used on the command line and by local image bases.

layers.description: Reusable filesystem layers keyed by layer name.
